originality.rationale: The exact coefficient-refined squarefree reciprocal count, arithmetic-progression bias and prime-versus-extension uniformity dichotomy were not covered in inspected mathematical statements; the reciprocal substitution alone and irreducible polynomial counting do not imply this squarefree character-sieved distribution. Residual unlocated-general-theorem risk remains. The closely related 2016 Mattarei–Pizzato treatment of quadratic transformations and irreducible self-reciprocals was inspected; it does not assert trace-refined squarefree counts.
residual_risks: An equivalent squarefree coefficient enumeration might be a corollary of an unlocated more general finite-field character-sieve formula; absence from searches does not prove uniqueness.

The Fourier-series derivation uses classical tools and can in principle be independently rediscovered; priority requires a more exhaustive specialist literature assessment.
